scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Odd coprime a>=5 and d>=1 only; denominator two, exactly four arithmetic-progression generators. The relevant Lee–Nam (2024) complete article was inaccessible; an implicit prior equivalent may exist. The proof is symbolic, and 1,550 finite test cases support rather than certify its unrestricted validity. Self-review only; no independent audit.
title: Pseudo-Frobenius numbers of halved four-term arithmetic-progression semigroups
